description: Capture breadth (integrations/capture_breadth.py) through the GET-only Graph client: two capture cycles over every mailbox of the tenant directory (ING-06; integrations/mail_capture_scope.json: all_mailboxes, the paged /users listing minus the explicit exclusion list, inbox and sent items, 90-day first-round window, at most 20 delta pages per folder per cycle, one cursor per mailbox folder) and the SharePoint scope (integrations/sharepoint_capture_scope.json: the whole QA/QC library, PLXCUSTOMERS Customer Documents, AGENTS Ontology UseCases), into the check's temporary Workbench state (outside the git tree). Cycle 2 must follow stored cursors only: each mail folder its stored nextLink/deltaLink, each SharePoint root whose full walk completed its drive's change feed. Attachment bytes are verified against Graph's metadata: mail by size (Graph publishes no mail attachment hash; SHA-256 pins the stored bytes), SharePoint by size and the published sha256Hash or quickXorHash; a failure is recorded, never silent. Completeness is per folder, complete_bound / bound_total over every scope folder with a named reason for each incomplete one; a mailbox Graph refuses (HTTP 403, e.g. outside the Exchange application access policy) stays in the denominator with reason forbidden and is counted in summary.mailboxes_forbidden. Then the exposed F7-F9 sources (evals/exposed/sources.json, cited by the dev-F7/F8/F9 exposed items) are located in the captures by source id, and the stores are read as a withheld actor (0 of everything). Counts, booleans and enums only; no addresses, names, paths, ids or content.
notes: Live-unverified until the live check runs it (module tests are injected-transport: integrations/tests/test_capture_breadth.py, test_capture_mail.py, test_capture_sharepoint.py). Captures live only in {tmp}/state and are deleted with the check's temporary directory. Completeness is asserted, not just recorded: the check fails as incomplete (complete_when: summary.complete, no forbidden mailbox, no budget-cut folder) while any scope folder is incomplete, and summary.mail_complete_bound/mail_bound_total and sharepoint_complete_bound/sharepoint_bound_total give the ratio per source, each source needing at least one complete unit. The 20-page budget per mail folder per cycle bounds a daily run, so a large folder stays incomplete with reason page_budget and resumes from its stored cursor; a SharePoint root bound by max_depth/max_folders is incomplete with that reason. Required: the tenant directory listed completely (summary.mail_directory complete, at least the 11 allowlisted mailboxes listed and opened with inbox and sent items), all 3 SharePoint targets resolved, no initial mail round started over in cycle 2 except after an expired token (a round that goes on from the page cursor the page budget or the time budget left is resumed, summary.rounds_resumed, never a rerun), zero mailboxes outside the allowlist, zero rows for a withheld actor. exposed_sources records how many of the F7-F9 cited sources resolve from the capture (by_status, by_kind); it is recorded, not required, because the 90-day window, the page budget and the walk bounds decide what one daily run holds. Unverified live assumptions: a SharePoint drive's root/delta accepts token=latest and answers ?token= links (a delta(token='...') link is refused by the guard and every root falls back to a full walk, full_walk_reason feed_unavailable); Graph honours Prefer: deltashowsharingchanges; the PLXCUSTOMERS site name resolves on the SHAREPOINT_SITE_ID host. GET only, token POST only. Tenant breadth (ING-06): every other directory mailbox is captured too, or recorded as a gap: forbidden (HTTP 403 from the Exchange application access policy) or not_visible, counted in summary.mailboxes_forbidden and runs[*].mailbox_status; a forbidden mailbox keeps the check incomplete (never complete) until PLX widens the access policy. Unverified live assumptions: /users with $select=id,mail,userType answers @odata.nextLink pages the guard accepts; a mailbox outside the access policy answers 403 on mailFolders (not 404). Time budget (--budget-seconds 6000 under the 6900 s timeout; live 2026-10-08 the check timed out at 6900 s): the cycles share it equally; within a cycle mail runs first within its declared share (half; --sharepoint-share) so it cannot spend SharePoint's, and SharePoint gets its share plus what mail left unused (runs[*].budget); it is asked before every mail delta page, SharePoint folder, item permission read and file; a folder or root it cuts is incomplete with reason time_budget (summary.folders_budget_cut) and is reported, never a timeout: a mail folder resumes from its stored cursor, and its cycle-2 round counts in summary.rounds_resumed, not rerun_initial_rounds; a SharePoint walk resumes from its stored position (cursor walk_position) and completes over several runs. Convergence (decision 2026-10-12-capture-cursor-convergence): a unit (mail folder or SharePoint root) whose work costs k budgets completes within k+1 runs, and a cut unit resumes first every run; the check therefore never requires runs[1].complete_bound > runs[0].complete_bound: a cut unit costing more than one budget leaves both runs at the same figure while it converges (recorded in runs[*].complete_bound and runs[*].folders[*].reason, not a failure), and a fresh state's two runs prove the bound only for k = 1. Item permissions: a complete SharePoint root following its drive's change feed passes over entries whose version is captured already, and once its permission position is older than permission_reread_hours (24 in integrations/sharepoint_capture_scope.json) it re-reads every listed file entry by item id (counts permissions_reread), so a grant revoked without the sharing annotation is stale at most that bound plus the runs the re-read takes (a re-read the time budget cuts resumes past the entries it read: k+1 runs for k budgets); with --runs 2 on a fresh state no root reaches it.
